outcome: Presence of antenatal corticosteroid (ACS) clinical practice guidelines
cohort: Clinical Managers at 52 secondary and tertiary maternity hospitals in Australia and New Zealand
finding: Significant variation exists in the recommendations provided by antenatal corticosteroid clinical practice guidelines across hospitals in Australia and New Zealand.
mod_finding: The abstract discusses antenatal corticosteroid guidelines and doesn't mention findings specific to mode of delivery.
